{{short description|German chemist and university teacher}}
'''Marika Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt''', nee '''von Mallinckrodt-Haupt''' (born 28 April 1923 in Potsdam; died 23 December 2016 in Erlangen) was a German chemist, physician and professor at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg|University of Erlangen]]. Her main focus in research was on forensic toxicology, forensic and clinical-toxicological analytics and ecogenetics.<ref name=":1">Franz-Ludwig-Gymnasium Bamberg: [http://wiki.bnv-bamberg.de/flg-wiki/index.php/Prof._Dr._Dr._Geldmacher-von_Mallinckrodt_Marika Prof. Dr. Dr. Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt Marika]</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.gtfch.org/cms/images/stories/media/tk/tk84_2/Schuetz_2017.pdf|title=Nachruf auf Frau Prof. Dr. phil. nat. Dr. med. Marika Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt (1923-2016)}}</ref>

== Life ==
After graduating from high school in Bamberg at the age of 16, Geldmacher von Mallinckrodt studied chemistry at the universities of Cologne, Munich and Erlangen from 1940 to 1948.<ref name=":0" /> In 1948, she was awarded a doctorate in natural sciences. The title of her dissertation was: "Ueber den Umsatz zwischen Schwefelstickstoff und Zinnchlorür, Zur Kenntnis des Tetraschwefeldinitrids S<sub>4</sub>N<sub>2</sub>".<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Ueber den Umsatz zwischen Schwefelstickstoff und Zinnchlorür: 1|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=idn%3D570227526|date=1948|place=o. O|first=Marika|last=Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt}}</ref> From 1949 to 1954, she studied medicine at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg|University of Erlangen]] and obtained her doctorate in medicine in July 1954. The title of her dissertation was "Die Elektrophorese der Kohlenhydrate".<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Die Elektrophorese der Kohlenhydrate|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=idn%3D480471835|date=1954|place=o. O|first=Marika|last=Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt}}</ref> From 1954 to 1963, she was a scientific assistant at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg|University of Erlangen-Nuremberg]], where she worked at the Institute for Forensic Medicine and Criminalistics.<ref name=":0" /> In 1960, she was recognized as a "Clinical Chemist" by the "Gesellschaft für Klinische Chemie".<ref name=":1" /> In 1964 she was awarded the [[venia legendi]] for the subject "Forensic Chemistry".<ref name=":1" /> She was awarded a professorship in 1970 and a C3 professorship in 1978.<ref name=":1" /> Marika Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt had been retired since 1985.<ref name=":0">GDCh – Arbeitskreis Chancengleichheit in der Chemie: ''[https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/Medien-DB/pci/chemikerinnen.pdf Chemikerinnen – es gab und es gibt sie.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131111113020/https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/Medien-DB/pci/chemikerinnen.pdf |date=2013-11-11 }}'', 2003.</ref>

On 6 December 1943 she married the Regierungsbaumeister Dr. Ing. Herbert Geldmacher.<ref name=":1" /> This marriage produced five children who were born in 1944, 1945, 1954, 1957 and 1966. Marika Geldmacher von Mallinckrodt had nine grandchildren.<ref name=":1" />

She was the daughter of dermatologist [[Asta von Mallinckrodt-Haupt]] and had 4 siblings.<ref name=":0" /> She was friends with [[Hildegard Hamm-Brücher]].<ref name=":2" />

== Research ==
A part of her research focused on toxicology. Due to her knowledge in medicine and chemistry, she helped treat intoxicated people. Furthermore, she built the basis for personalized medicine by investigating ethnic characteristics of the metabolism and their percentage distribution in the respective population. To do so, she asked her doctoral students for blood samples from all over the world. For example, she investiaged the differences in sensitivity to insecticides (e.g., [[E605|E 605]]).<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dgrm.de/startseite/news-dgrm/nachruf-auf-frau-prof-geldmacher-von-mallinckrodt/|title=Nachruf auf Frau Prof. Geldmacher von Mallinckrodt}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt|first=Marika|last2=Diepgen|first2=Thomas L.|date=1988-12-01|title=The human serum paraoxonase—Polymorphism and specificity|journal=Toxicological & Environmental Chemistry|volume=18|issue=2–3|pages=79–196|doi=10.1080/02772248809357310|issn=0277-2248}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
Marika Geldmacher von Mallinckrodt wrote more than 130 scientific articles in books and journals.<ref name=":0" /> In 1976 she published her book "Einfache Untersuchungen auf Gifte im klinisch-chemischen Laboratorium" (Simple tests for toxins in clinical chemistry laboratories).<ref name=":1" /> In 1989 she published together with Hans J. Gibitz "Klinisch-toxikologische Analytik bei akuten Vergiftungen und Drogenmissbrauch".<ref name=":1" /> She was co-author of the books "Gerichtliche Medizin" (1975), "Metalle in der [[Umwelt]]" (1984), "Lehrbuch der Klinischen Chemie und Pathobiochemie" (1987, 1989, 1995), "Metals and their Compounds in the Environment" (1991), "Handbook on Metals in Clinical Chemistry" (1995).<ref name=":1" /> She was also editor of the "Mitteilungen der Kommission für klinisch-toxikologische Analytik der Deutschen Forschungsgemeinschaft" from 1982 to 1995.<ref name=":1" />

== Awards ==
In 1980 the city of Erlangen awarded Mallinckrodt's Geldmacher-von Mallinckrodt the Ehrenbrief.<ref name=":1" /> In 1986 she was awarded the Jean Servais Stas Medal of the Society for Toxicological and Forensic Chemistry.<ref name=":1" /> In 1987 she was awarded the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]].<ref name=":0" />
